# Getting help

- **Questions and ideas:** open an issue using the feature request template.
- **Bugs:** use the bug report template. Include your versions and the exact error text.
- **Shodan itself** (query credits, plans, account issues, scan data): see [Shodan help](https://help.shodan.io/). This server only calls the Shodan REST API and CVEDB.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** report privately via [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/w0h1v/mcp-shodan/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
